user_query: I'm planning a wine and cheese pairing dinner for my friends and I need some recommendations on the best wines and cheese to pair. Can you provide me with a list of recommended wine and cheese pairings? Additionally, I would like to know the details of my wine cart to ensure I have all the necessary items for the dinner. Also, suggest some nearby breweries where we can visit after the dinner.

TaskList.description: Gather recommendations for wine and cheese pairings based on common pairings and expert suggestions.
Fetch details from the user's wine cart to ensure all necessary items are present for the dinner.
Search for nearby breweries that can be visited after the dinner, providing details like distance and ratings.

dependencies.description: Wine cart details depend on the wine recommendations.
Brewery suggestions do not depend on previous steps.
